targets.name: Barnard's Star
targets.blurb: La estrella con mayor movimiento propio conocido: ~10.4"/año.
targets.why: Se mueve ~1.7 px por año de SPHEREx, pero satura el detector: PRISM lo muestra con banderas, no lo oculta.

en.why: Moves ~1.7 px per SPHEREx year but saturates the detector; PRISM flags it instead of hiding it.

expected.basis: K ~ 4.5 mag; M4 study found OVERFLOW/BLOOM flags at predicted positions

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)

targets.name: Epsilon Indi B
targets.blurb: Par de enanas marrones T a 12 años luz; ~4.7"/año.
targets.why: Movimiento menor que un píxel por temporada y vecina brillante (eps Ind A): prueba de artefactos.

en.why: Sub-pixel motion per season next to a bright star (eps Ind A): an artifact test.

expected.basis: T-dwarf binary ~7.3' from the bright star eps Ind A (ghost/crosstalk risk)

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)

targets.name: WISE 0855-0714
targets.blurb: La enana marrón más fría conocida (~285 K); ~8.2"/año.
targets.why: Invisible por debajo de ~3.5 µm: aparece sólo en D5/D6. Color y movimiento separados.

en.why: Invisible below ~3.5 um: only D5/D6 see it. Colour and motion, separated.

expected.basis: Y dwarf, [4.5]=13.9 vs [3.6]=17.4 (Luhman 2014): only long-wave detectors

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)

catalog.query: SELECT b.main_id,b.ra,b.dec,b.coo_bibcode,b.pmra,b.pmdec,b.pm_bibcode,b.plx_value,b.plx_bibcode,b.rvz_radvel,b.otype FROM basic AS b JOIN ident AS i ON i.oidref=b.oid WHERE i.id='WISE J085510.83-071442.5'

targets.name: RW Aurigae
targets.blurb: Estrella T Tauri joven con apagones irregulares.
targets.why: Variable real: cambia de brillo entre temporadas, no de posición.

en.blurb: Young T Tauri star with irregular dimmings.
en.why: A true variable: brightness changes between seasons, not position.

expected.basis: Bright T Tauri star (K ~ 7); saturation expected in several detectors

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)

catalog.query: SELECT b.main_id,b.ra,b.dec,b.coo_bibcode,b.pmra,b.pmdec,b.pm_bibcode,b.plx_value,b.plx_bibcode,b.rvz_radvel,b.otype FROM basic AS b JOIN ident AS i ON i.oidref=b.oid WHERE i.id='V* RW Aur'

targets.name: R Draconis
targets.blurb: Variable Mira con periodo de ~245 días.
targets.why: Un periodo cabe en el lapso de SPHEREx: el brillo cambia mucho entre temporadas.

en.why: One period fits within the SPHEREx span: large brightness changes between seasons.

expected.basis: Mira variable, near-IR very bright; saturation expected

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)

targets.name: M101 (Pinwheel Galaxy)
targets.blurb: Galaxia espiral: un campo de control estático.
targets.why: Nada debería moverse aquí. Sirve para calibrar qué parece cambio y no lo es.

en.blurb: Spiral galaxy: a static control field.
en.why: Nothing should move here. Calibrates what looks like change but is not.

expected.basis: Extended galaxy; static reference field (the existing /frames demo)

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)
